policy: Every known release failure requires a permanent automated blocker before the next candidate tag.

incidents.rootCause: Legacy and normalized payment fields were both accepted, leaving inactive partial configuration ambiguous.
OCI index, platform manifest, Docker image ID and release digest were previously compared inconsistently.
Deployable changes were stacked on non-main PR bases and could be omitted from the final release line.
incidents.automaticBlocker: tag commit must be reachable from origin/main

incidents.rootCause: GitHub diagnostic artifact quota failures were mixed with test and formal evidence status.
incidents.automaticBlocker: diagnostic artifacts are non-blocking; formal OSS evidence remains blocking

incidents.rootCause: Root health checks did not prove guest table QR, reservation and staff routes worked.
DNS, TLS and callback host failures were first detected after deployment.
Database work could begin before the exact runtime configuration and migration lineage were validated.
A failure after traffic switching required reliable restoration of an already loaded previous image.
incidents.automaticBlocker: automatic rollback plus previous public identity verification

incidents.rootCause: The canonical environment allowlist removed store credential and employee PIN fields, while preflight did not validate the store provisioning contract.
incidents.automaticBlocker: store-aware runtime preflight before backup or database work

incidents.rootCause: External preflight sent an IP address as the TLS SNI server name, relying on behavior deprecated by the Node.js runtime.
The Alibaba Cloud PEM archive included a self-signed root certificate and the installer probed the reloaded TLS listener before it was ready.
incidents.automaticBlocker: normalized certificate-chain activation plus bounded TLS application probe

incidents.rootCause: A disposable PostgreSQL migration hook inherited the 10-second unit-test default and could fail under runner contention after all business assertions remained healthy.
incidents.automaticBlocker: bounded 30-second normalized database setup hook timeout

incidents.rootCause: Replacing the host Caddyfile inode left the running container attached to the old bind-mounted inode, so a valid host candidate was invisible to Caddy.
incidents.automaticBlocker: inode-preserving Caddyfile write plus host-to-container SHA256 visibility gate
